title: lycopersicon aethiopicum
intro: Lycopersicon aethiopicum, commonly known as the African tomato or yellow tomato, is a variety of nightshade that belongs to the Solanaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including being a rich source of antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals that help to boost the immune system and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lycopersicon aethiopicum include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as it has anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carotenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes.
